answer.reason: Two events of the story belong to Media: Israel's exiles were settled in its cities, and the LORD raised up its kings against Babylon.

clauses.english: received the exiles of Israel in its cities after Samaria fell
clauses.quote: and in the cities of the Medes

clauses.english: had the spirit of its kings raised up by the LORD to destroy Babylon
clauses.quote: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes

doubts: ISA 21:2 ("besiege, O Media") is a call in a vision, not a recorded event, so it is left out.
EZR 6:2, where a roll was found in the province of the Medes, only names the place, so it is left out.
